title: Staff Engineer I, TSG Software Engineering
description:
COMPANY PROFILE
  
  
Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.
  
  
Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefine industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.
  
  
The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals - serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics - who support our offices globally. Our mantra of "shared innovation, seamless execution," underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.
  
  
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK
  
  
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.
  
  
Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
  
  
You’ll work as a member of an Agile/scrum software development team focused exclusively on building and supporting Bain’s most strategic internal software systems. Team members work collaboratively to design, build and implement new features and functionality in their systems aimed at delivering the most value to Bain’s global users and supporting key business initiatives. Systems developed are primarily enterprise-scale browser based or mobile applications developed with current Microsoft development languages and technologies, with a global user base and integration points with one or more other internal Bain systems.
  
  
WHAT YOU’LL DO
  
  
The Staff Engineer I is a senior role who can independently handle a software module/function which includes technical delivery, stakeholder management and communication. The role is also responsible for aligning the technical delivery goals with product vision. The individual is also responsible for coaching and mentoring of the team from technical delivery standpoint.
  
  
Technical Delivery (75%)
  
  

* Provide module-level technical leadership on teams developing and updating enterprise scale applications at Bain.
* Work as a member of an agile software development team with full participation in all Agile team events and activities.
* Take lead for the development of more complex components or functions with special requirements within a sprint. Understand the links between stories and desired outcomes and support the Engineering Manager and Product Owner with product strategy.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of business and domain. Support Product Owner and Engineering Manager in defining product roadmap and backlog by providing technical input.
* Work in collaboration with other team members on an agile team to analyze user stories, perform task breakdown and define technical approach and complete committed tasks as per sprint schedule. Support junior team members in analyzing requirements and completion of technical tasks.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of using the underlying application development infrastructure.
* Help improve the infrastructure to optimize the application development.
* Contribute in the design, architecting and prototyping of applications and significant application upgrades primarily working with Engineering Managers, Architects and Project/Product Managers.
* Prepare work estimates for committed components and support/review other team members’ estimates. Actively make recommendations to the other team members for their task allocations to promote skill diversity and growth.
* Write unit test plans for committed components. Execute and confirm successful completion of unit tests as part of the criteria for completion. In addition, review and support unit testing completed by other team members.
* Contribute to planning and participate in the testing and release of application releases.
* Provide ongoing support for applications already in use. This includes problem diagnosis and resolution, ad hoc reporting support and database administration.
* Demonstrate ability to acquire new skills e.g. creating automation tests using selenium, creating UX designs, DevOps, performing functional/load testing etc. through internal/external trainings to be a T-Shaped team member helping the team in achieving sprint goals.
* Help ensure adherence to Bain development project process and standards within the agile team as well as actively participating in the continual evolution of processes and standards.
* Write and review technical documentation prepared by the team.

Research (10%)
  
  

* Contribute to evaluating and employing new and/or supplemental technologies necessary to deliver functionality for a given software application.
* Actively promote the research and evaluation of new tools and technologies beyond current product requirements that are likely to be used in future initiatives. Lead the presentation of findings and recommendations to the full Software Development team.

Communication (10%)
  
  

* Clearly communicate and exchange ideas across multiple fronts e.g., design, technical solutions.
* Demonstrate assertion in communication while working with team and stakeholders during crucial conversations.
* Has strong listening skills to recognize needs of a team-member, and acts to deliver a great team experience.
* Participate in internal skill development by sharing concepts and technologies with the full Software Development team.
* Provide feedback to Scrum Master, Engineering Manager and Product Owner to improve team performance. Shares best practices across software group.

Mentoring (5%)
  
  

* Provide day to day technical guidance and mentoring to 1-3 less experienced engineers on the agile team.

ABOUT YOU
  
  

* 8-12 years in software engineering, including 2-3 years of technical leadership experience in owning complex modules, driving architecture decisions, and mentoring developers.
* Demonstrated knowledge of agile software development methodologies and processes.
* Understanding of core architecture of the product and ability to suggest new technologies and approaches as per the product vision.
* Ability to deliver the assigned work independently with Zero D.
* Demonstrated record of strong performance in prior software development positions.
* Strong communication and customer service skills.
* Strong analytic and problem-solving skills.
* Experience developing enterprise scale applications.
* Demonstrated record of T shape behavior to expedite delivery by managing conflicts/contingencies.
* Experience in managing a group of developers from technical leadership standpoint.
* Bachelor’s or equivalent degree.

Software Engineering - Technical Skills
  
  

* Frameworks: .NET & .NET Core
* Languages: C#, T-SQL
* Web frameworks/Lib: Angular, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, etc.
* RDBMS: Microsoft SQL Server
* Cloud: Microsoft Azure Services
* Unit testing: XUnit, Jasmine, etc.
* DevOps: GitActions
* Web frameworks/Lib: React
* Search engine: Elasticsearch, Coveo, etc.
* NoSQL databases: MongoDB, Cosmos, etc.
* Caching: Redis, MemCache

title: Global IT Configuration Engineer Manager
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

As Manager – SaaS Engineering for SAP Fieldglass, you will serve as the technical configuration lead for the global implementation of SAP Fieldglass. You will own the end-to-end configuration strategy and execution, ensuring the system is designed, built, and deployed in alignment with the global operating model.

This is a hands-on role requiring deep SAP Fieldglass expertise. You will act as the internal design authority, partner closely with implementation partner, Product analyst and cross functional teams to ensure technical rigor across configuration build, testing, and deployment phases.

You will balance strategic oversight with detailed configuration execution to ensure scalability, compliance, and long-term sustainability of the solution. Also, you will act as the Fieldglass reporting expert within our team and ensure reporting standards and knowledge are maintained to a high degree while also delivering ongoing reporting support to our end users

Among your responsibilities, you will:

* Lead global configuration design for SAP Fieldglass, including:
* Workflows and approval chains
* Business rules and compliance controls
* Rate structures and complex pricing models
* SOW and milestone billing configurations
* Security model and role-based access design
* Establish configuration standards and governance processes
* Serve as primary technical counterpart to system integrators and external partners
* Validate and challenge solution designs to ensure scalability and alignment with business objectives
* Oversee integration design and validation with Workday, SAP S4HANA, Coupa, and other systems
* Lead configuration build reviews and technical quality assurance
* Manage quarterly SAP Fieldglass release assessments and regression strategy during implementation
* Identify risks related to data, compliance, and architecture
* Provide thought leadership on platform optimization and long-term roadmap

What You'll Bring

* 7-10+ years of SaaS or enterprise system configuration experience
* 4+ years deep SAP Fieldglass configuration expertise (required)
* Experience leading configuration workstreams in at least one global SAP Fieldglass implementation (required)
* Strong understanding of contingent workforce and services procurement processes
* Experience working with system implementation partner and global vendors
* Strong knowledge of integrations (Workday, SAP, Coupa, middleware)
* Experience managing release governance and change control processes
* Bachelor’s degree required
* Strong technical troubleshooting skills, including debugging and analysis of performance issues
* Strong communication skills and ability to work closely with users and provide a high level of customer service in a friendly, professional manner

Preferred:

* Experience in consulting or professional services environments
* Experience in multi-country deployments
* Knowledge of compliance and audit considerations (e.g., data privacy, worker classification controls)

Who You'll Work With

As Manager – SaaS Engineering for SAP Fieldglass, you will work with:

* Other members of the squad, including Product Owner, analysts, testers and scrum master
* Global stakeholders including HR, Finance and business owners
* System implementation partner, MSP and global vendors
* IT integrations and delivery teams supporting broader applications

Additional info

**YOU’RE GOOD AT**

* To be successful, this individual must
* Have a deep technical understanding of the SAP Fieldglass system functionality and apply that knowledge to support global implementation
* Designing complex SaaS configurations in enterprise environments
* Thinking holistically about system architecture and cross-system impacts
* Balancing global standardization with regional localization needs
* Challenging vendors and integrators constructively to drive better outcomes
* Translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions
* Troubleshooting complex configuration and integration issues
* Communicating technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders
* Have a sense of urgency in task execution, be well organized, able to solve complex issues and be interested in meeting high expectations while working in a very rewarding environment offering exceptional opportunities for learning and growth
* Create clear and comprehensive specification documents for application modifications and new functionality additions.
* Stay abreast of functional, technical & development tools, trends and practices, and act as an evangelist for items that should be considered for future initiatives

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

* Manage and supervise between 3-6 direct reports within the development team. These individuals are typically working on the team they directly support. Responsible for the individuals’ PD and career development.

Strategy, planning and technology leadership (25%)
  

* Support the Scrum Master in improving delivery metrics like velocity, responsiveness, predictability, quality, etc.
* Advise business and technology partners on technology solutions leveraging emerging technologies and on mitigation of disruption risk.
* Prepare and maintain the long-term technology roadmap for the product based on the product vision. Work with the Product Owner, System Architect, Data Architect and engineering team members for its implementation.

ABOUT YOU
  

* Experience in software development including work on all aspects of the development life cycle.
* Solid understanding of Agile Methodology with experience in managing sprints/ scrums and user stories while using tools such as VSTS, Jira, etc.
* Experience architecting applications and working on enterprise-wide systems.
* Experience leading technical teams on small to medium size projects.
* Demonstrated record of strong performance in prior software development positions.
* Strong communication, time management and customer service skills.
* High performance and standards as demonstrated by academic or previous job experience.

**Data Engineering - Technical skills:**  

* Languages: SQL, PySpark, Python, Scala
* Data Storage & Analytics: Delta Lake, Unity catalog, Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL, Azure Data Lake, Blob Storage, etc.
* ETL Tools: Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory
* Cloud-based data warehouse and Lakehouse architectures on Microsoft Azure
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Azure Databricks, ADLS, ADF, Azure Logic app

Experience
  

* 8-10 experience in software development including work on all aspects of the development life cycle.

title: CIS PROJECT MANAGEMENT-CIS PORTFOLIO MANAGEMENT
description:
**Role Summary**

We are hiring a **Technical Project Manager (Contractual)** to lead **high‑complexity technology programs** with strategic impact. This role focuses on **automation and AI‑driven transformation** , including **RPA (UiPath/Automation Anywhere)** and **Generative AI initiatives** for banking and payments. You will own delivery end‑to‑end—scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk, and stakeholder management—while enabling engineering teams to execute with clarity and velocity. Hands on exp on AI based implementation for Contact Center and Back Office (IVA, Agent Assist, Unified Desktop etc).

**Key Responsibilities**

**Delivery Leadership**

* Own program delivery from initiation through transition; establish integrated scope–schedule–cost–quality baseline and control changes through governance.
* Drive execution with stage gates and Agile/Hybrid cadence; manage RAID proactively.

**Stakeholder & Client Management**

* Serve as primary contact for internal/external stakeholders; run governance ceremonies and publish transparent status reporting.

**Technical Enablement**

* Translate business outcomes into technical work packages; ensure non‑functional requirements (security, performance, compliance) are embedded.
* Guide teams across **cloud, APIs/integration, data/analytics, CI/CD/DevSecOps** , and **automation/AI platforms** ; remove technical blockers.

**Financials & Compliance**

* Own budget, forecast, and variance; track EAC/ETC, CPI/SPI; ensure audit readiness and regulatory compliance.

**People & Ways of Working**

* Coach PMs/Scrum Masters; reinforce lean, data‑driven delivery practices; clarify PM vs BA boundaries per R\&R guidance.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering/Computer Science (or equivalent).
* Proven track record leading **large technology programs** in BFSI/payments with automation and AI components.
* Mastery of PM disciplines: planning, estimation, governance, vendor management, financial control.
* Hands on exp on AI based implementation for Contact Center and Back Office (IVA, Agent Assist, Unified Desktop etc).
* Technical fluency in **RPA (UiPath/Automation Anywhere)** and **Generative AI use cases** , plus cloud and integration patterns.
* Tools: MS Project, Azure DevOps/Jira, Power BI.
* Certifications: AI/ML, Python, PMP/PRINCE2 and Agile (CSM/SAFe),

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Domain depth in payments, cards, acquiring/issuing, or risk/compliance.
* Experience with **AI‑assisted delivery** and automation frameworks.

title: Scrum Lead
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  

We are seeking an experienced and passionate Scrum Master to serve as a servant leader, agile coach, and delivery facilitator for one or more cross\-functional software development teams. The Scrum Master will be responsible for enabling teams to deliver high\-value products through Agile best practices, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, removing impediments, and driving collaboration across business and technology stakeholders.

  

The ideal candidate combines deep Agile expertise with strong leadership, coaching, facilitation, and problem\-solving skills. This individual will partner closely with Product Owners, Engineering Leaders, Business Stakeholders, Data Science, Data Engineering, and Development teams to improve team effectiveness, delivery predictability, and business outcomes.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Serve as a Scrum Master for one or more Agile teams, ensuring effective adoption of Scrum principles, values, and practice
* Act as a servant leader and coach, enabling teams to become self\-organizing, cross\-functional, and high\-performing
* Guide teams in Agile maturity and continuously drive process improvements
* Coach Product Owners, stakeholders, and team members on Agile methodologies, Lean principles, and best practices
* Promote a culture of accountability, transparency, collaboration, and continuous learning
* Facilitate Agile ceremonies like Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Sprint Reviews, Sprint Retrospectives, Backlog Refinement Sessions
* Ensure ceremonies are productive, outcome\-focused, and aligned with business priorities
* Foster healthy team discussions and decision\-making processes
* Partner with Product Owners to maintain a healthy, prioritized, and well\-defined backlog
* Ensure sprint goals are clear, realistic, and aligned with organizational objectives
* Monitor sprint execution and proactively identify risks, dependencies, and blockers
* Facilitate timely resolution of impediments to maintain team flow and productivity
* Support teams in achieving predictable and sustainable delivery
* Metrics, Reporting \& Continuous Improvement
	+ Track and analyze Agile metrics
	+ Use data and insights to drive meaningful conversations and continuous improvement initiatives
	+ Establish dashboards and reporting mechanisms to provide visibility into team performance and delivery health
	+ Facilitate retrospectives that result in measurable improvements
* Stakeholder Collaboration
	+ Serve as a bridge between engineering teams, product teams, business stakeholders, and leadership
	+ Facilitate effective communication and alignment across multiple teams and departments
	+ Manage cross\-team dependencies and support planning across multiple Agile teams
	+ Provide regular updates on delivery status, risks, and mitigation plans
* Risk \& Dependency Management
	+ Identify, document, manage, and resolve project risks and impediments
	+ Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to address dependency\-related challenges
	+ Escalate critical issues appropriately while maintaining ownership of resolution efforts
* Agile Transformation \& Organizational Impact
	+ Champion Agile mindset adoption across the organization
	+ Support organizational Agile transformation initiatives
	+ Mentor new Scrum Masters and team members
	+ Contribute to Agile Communities of Practice and knowledge\-sharing initiatives
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Graduate degree or equivalent experience
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), SAFe Scrum Master (SSM), or equivalent certification
* 7\+ years Experience in enterprise\-scale Agile environments
* Experience supporting technology, data, analytics, or AI/ML teams
* Exposure to PI Planning, ART events, and SAFe practices

 **Success Measures:**

* Improved sprint predictability and delivery reliability
* Effective removal of team impediments
* Solid stakeholder satisfaction and communication
* Increased Agile maturity and self\-sufficiency of supported teams
* Demonstrated continuous improvement through measurable delivery outcomes

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: R&D Engineer 3, Software
description:
Overview:

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our \~16,800 employees create world\-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.
Our award\-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry\-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.  

DP\-COE (Digital Photonics Center of Excellence), being part of Keysight Technologies has the responsibility for developing innovative products in the crucial portfolio segment of Oscilloscopes, Photonics, AWG (Arbitrary Waveform Generator), BERT (Bit Error Rate Tester), Digitizer, Logic Analysis, Protocol Analysis which provide fast, extensive insight and enable engineering teams to do their job faster, with higher quality. We serve our customers in the Computer, Semiconductor, Wireless, Automotive, Storage and Communication, Quantum industries with leading edge products and solutions. Keysight Solution teams work closely with DP\-COE to provide required solutions to these industries.
Responsibilities:

As a Test \& Measurement Software Engineer (AI Solutions), you will develop and integrate software that brings AI\-powered capabilities into our digital measurement instrument products, in a highly collaborative, fast\-paced environment with international teams. You will work on defined assignments under the direction of the senior engineer on site and the Solutions Architect, delivering reliable, well\-tested, maintainable software through the full development lifecycle. This is a deliberately broad role: expect to move across product features, test automation, evaluation harnesses, and developer tooling depending on what the team needs, which makes it a strong fit for an engineer who wants to build both AI and measurement depth rather than specialize narrowly on day one.  

You will work closely with the senior engineer, Solutions Architect, R\&D Project Manager, Product Management, QA and validation, and other stakeholders to deliver new product offerings and improve existing ones. There will be significant ongoing interaction with our design teams located in the United States and Germany, so the candidate should be a strong team worker and should be able and willing to collaborate across sites and time zones.
Qualifications:
**Essential:*** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science (or equivalent) with strong software engineering skills.
* Typically 4\-5 years of relevant software development experience.
* Proficiency in one or more modern software languages such as C\+\+ or C\#.
* Solid grounding in software design patterns, testing, and debugging, with the ability to work independently on defined assignments.
* Experience with Git and CI/CD pipeline workflows.
* Demonstrated experience delivering software components into production or product environments.
* Familiarity with — and a strong desire to learn — how AI\-powered software is built (e.g., retrieval\-augmented generation and agentic techniques).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Excellent team player, responsive and accountable.
* Self\-starter. Willing and able to quickly learn new applications and technologies.
* Willing and able to collaborate with international teams (US, Europe).
 **Preferred:**  

* Working knowledge of, or hands\-on exposure to, Keysight instruments like oscilloscopes, BERTs or AWGs — or a strong foundation in a closely related measurement or signal\-processing domain with the ability to ramp quickly.
* Experience developing instrument, embedded, or real\-time software, including hardware/software integration or signal\-processing pipelines.
* Hands\-on exposure to AI/ML libraries or agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or similar orchestration toolkits.
* Experience building test automation frameworks or evaluation tooling for non\-deterministic systems.
* Exposure to deploying AI/ML models on edge or embedded platforms.
* Familiarity with responsible AI practices and explainability tooling (e.g., SHAP, LIME).
* Atlassian tool experience — Bitbucket, Confluence, Jira.
* Scrum agile software development process background.
* Test\-driven development experience.

* Excellent team player, responsive and accountable.
* Self\-starter. Willing and able to quickly learn new applications and technologies.
* Experience in international collaboration (US, Europe).
 **Preferred:**  

* Experience with Keysight instruments like oscilloscopes, BERTs or AWGs — or a strong foundation in a closely related measurement or signal\-processing domain with the ability to ramp quickly.
* Hands\-on experience with agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or similar orchestration toolkits.
* Experience building multi\-agent systems or custom orchestration layers, including agent roles, tool calls, memory, and reasoning loops.
* Experience deploying AI/ML models on edge or embedded platforms, including model quantization, pruning, and on\-device inference optimization.
* Knowledge of hardware/software integration, FPGA data pipelines, or low\-level driver interfaces relevant to AI\-assisted signal processing.
* Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, explainability tooling (SHAP, LIME, attention visualization), and responsible AI practices.
* Experience implementing secure AI data flows with attention to data integrity and traceability.
* Atlassian tool experience — Bitbucket, Confluence, Jira.
* Scrum agile software development process background.
* Test\-driven development experience.
* Prior experience as the senior engineer at a satellite or secondary engineering site.

title: Release Train Engineer
description:
About This Role
**5 years of experience**  

**Skills: SAFe 5, RTE, PI Planning, ART Sync, Stakeholder Engagement, Agile, Banking, Capital Markets, DevOps, Jira/confluence**

**About the Role** We are looking for an experienced Release Train Engineer (RTE) with 5\+ years of experience to lead and facilitate Agile Release Train (ART) delivery You will serve as a servant leader and coach for the ART — facilitating PI Planning, managing cross\-team dependencies, removing impediments, and driving continuous improvement across the delivery organisation. Banking and capital markets domain experience is essential for this role — enabling you to engage credibly with business stakeholders, understand regulatory delivery constraints, and navigate the governance frameworks of a complex financial services environment.


**Key Responsibilities**


ART Facilitation \& Delivery


* Facilitate and coordinate all ART\-level ceremonies — PI Planning, ART Sync, System Demos, and Inspect \& Adapt workshops — ensuring effective cross\-team alignment and programme increment delivery.
* Manage and coordinate delivery across two squads of 7 — ensuring teams are aligned to PI objectives, dependencies are managed, and risks are identified and mitigated proactively.
* Track and manage ART\-level programme board — maintaining visibility of features, dependencies, risks, and milestones across both squads throughout each programme increment.
* Facilitate cross\-team dependency resolution — identifying blockers, coordinating between squads, and escalating impediments that cannot be resolved at team level.
* Support squad\-level Scrum Masters — providing coaching, guidance, and facilitation support to ensure effective Agile ceremonies and team delivery rhythms.
* Monitor and report ART\-level delivery metrics — velocity, predictability, feature completion, and PI objective achievement — providing clear, evidence\-based progress updates to programme leadership.
* Coordinate System Demo preparation and execution — ensuring both squads deliver integrated, demonstrable working software at the end of each programme increment.

Continuous Improvement \& Coaching


* Lead Inspect \& Adapt workshops — facilitating structured retrospectives at ART level, identifying systemic improvement opportunities, and driving measurable delivery improvement.
* Coach squads, Product Owners, and stakeholders on SAFe principles, Agile practices, and continuous improvement mindset.
* Champion DevOps and continuous delivery practices — supporting squads in improving build, test, and deployment automation to accelerate feature delivery.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and psychological safety across both squads — enabling high\-performing, self\-organising teams.

Stakeholder Management \& Governance


* Act as the primary ART\-level communication interface — providing regular, clear delivery status updates to programme managers, product leadership, and senior stakeholders.
* Manage relationships with Business Owners, Product Management, and key stakeholders — facilitating business engagement in PI Planning, System Demos, and governance forums.
* Contribute to portfolio\-level planning — providing ART capacity, dependency, and risk inputs to support programme and portfolio prioritisation decisions.
* Support risk and compliance governance — ensuring ART delivery activities align to organisational delivery standards, change management processes, and regulatory requirements within a banking and capital markets environment.
* Maintain ART\-level documentation — PI plans, programme boards, risk registers, and retrospective action logs.

**What We're Looking For**


* 5\+ years of experience in Agile delivery roles — Scrum Master, RTE, or Agile Coach — with at least 2–3 years as a Release Train Engineer in a SAFe environment.


* Deep SAFe expertise — PI Planning facilitation, ART coordination, programme board management, and Inspect \& Adapt — with proven ability to lead ARTs of 10–15\+ people.


* **Banking and capital markets domain experience — essential** — understanding of financial services delivery constraints, regulatory governance, and capital markets technology programmes.


* Experience managing cross\-team dependencies and delivery coordination across multiple squads in fast\-paced programme delivery environments.


* Strong servant leadership and coaching skills — supporting Scrum Masters, Product Owners, and squad members in Agile best practices.


* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills — engaging senior business and technology stakeholders with clear, concise ART\-level delivery reporting.


* Proficiency with Agile tooling — Jira, Confluence, Miro — for PI planning, programme board management, and delivery reporting.


* Strong facilitation skills — leading large\-group PI Planning events, System Demos, and Inspect \& Adapt workshops with energy, structure, and impact.


* Good understanding of DevOps and continuous delivery practices — supporting squads in improving automation and deployment frequency.


* Strong analytical mindset — interpreting ART delivery metrics and driving data\-informed continuous improvement.


**Nice to Have**


* SAFe Release Train Engineer (RTE) certification — SAFe 5 or SAFe 6\.
* SAFe Programme Consultant (SPC) certification.
* Experience in capital markets technology programmes — trade reporting, regulatory platforms, market data, or trading systems delivery.
* Familiarity with LPM (Lean Portfolio Management) and portfolio\-level Agile governance.
* Experience with scaled Agile tooling — Jira Align, Rally, or equivalent ART\-level planning tools.
* Agile coaching certification — ICP\-ACC or equivalent.
* Exposure to regulatory delivery programmes — MiFID II, EMIR, APRA, or equivalent financial services regulatory change.
